checkable.sympy: from sympy import *; x1,x2,x3=symbols('x1 x2 x3'); u=[Function(f'u{i}')(x1,x2,x3) for i in (1,2,3)]; X=[x1,x2,x3]; curl=lambda w:[diff(w[2],x2)-diff(w[1],x3),diff(w[0],x3)-diff(w[2],x1),diff(w[1],x1)-diff(w[0],x2)]; div=lambda w:sum(diff(w[i],X[i]) for i in range(3)); lap=lambda f:sum(diff(f,xi,2) for xi in X); simplify([curl(curl(u))[i]-(diff(div(u),X[i])-lap(u[i])) for i in range(3)])
checkable.asserts: curl curl u = grad div u − Laplacian u (all components zero), the identity behind the div/curl split
